/groomers/saskatchewan/saskatoon/tlc-gro.lead: TLC Grooming is a Saskatoon pet grooming salon at 3120 Laurier Drive, Unit 2. Its official service page separates full grooms from bath-and-tidy visits and lists nail care, ear cleaning, pad trimming, brushing, de-matting or de-shedding, styling, shampooing, conditioning, and drying. It also advertises walk-in nail trims, a three-visit puppy acclimation program for puppies 12 weeks and older, a shed-less program, and selected spa add-ons. The site asks customers to call for core grooming prices, so this profile does not estimate a business-specific full-groom rate. The public listing snapshot reports 4.3 stars from 59 reviews. Confirm availability, package fit, and current policies directly before booking.
/groomers/saskatchewan/saskatoon/tlc-gro.summary: The first-party service menu gives this profile more decision value than a basic name-and-address record. Customers can distinguish a full groom from a bath-and-tidy visit, identify walk-in nail care and puppy acclimation options, and see that de-matting or de-shedding may be included in the published packages. The official site also makes clear that customers should call for core grooming prices, which is why this directory avoids inventing a salon-specific quote.

/groomers/nova-scotia/falmouth/the-barks.lead: The Barkshire Club is a Falmouth pet grooming and daycare business at 2037 Evangeline Trail. Its first-party grooming menu separates dog full grooms from bath-only packages and also publishes cat grooming options. Dog full grooms and baths include a bath, blowout, and nail trim, while full-groom pricing is organized by weight. A Puppy Pamper introduces puppies aged three to six months to bathing and drying, with nail or light scissor work when temperament permits. The business also lists grooming add-ons, walk-in services, prepaid package savings, online booking, and a direct phone number. Confirm the correct package, coat-condition fees, availability, and current total before booking.
/groomers/nova-scotia/falmouth/the-barks.summary: This manually reviewed profile uses the business's current contact page and service menus instead of relying only on an older map snapshot. Owners can compare full-groom, bath-only, puppy, and cat options, see what the base dog packages include, and check the business's published starting prices. The official contact page also separates grooming hours from daycare hours. Prices may change and are listed before HST, so the directory links to the first-party pages rather than treating them as a guaranteed quote.
